hero.offer: 1- to 4-room apartments from 30 to 103 m² in the new Block E. Every apartment has a balcony or terrace, and the grounds include 4,530 m² of recreation areas.

project.title: Ten floors above a green courtyard
project.lead: Isani Park Residence is a residential complex by Mono Capitals on Beri Gabriel Salosi Avenue in Tbilisi's Isani district. Apartments in Block E are now for sale, from compact 1-room units to 4-room homes with generous terraces.
project.imageAlt: Visualisation of Block E: a ten-storey building with terracotta piers and balconies above a landscaped courtyard
project.imageCaption: The design may be refined during construction.

facts.note: on an 8,550 m² site (Blocks F and E)

project.source: Site and recreation areas are taken from the official Mono Capitals website. Apartment, floor and parking-space counts come from the Block E design plans.

living.title: What comes with the apartment

items.title: Your own outdoor space
items.text: Every apartment in Block E has an outdoor area: a balcony in the smaller units and terraces of up to 29 m² in the 4-room apartments. The exact figure is listed for each apartment.

items.title: A courtyard for walks and play
items.text: The developer lists landscaped recreation areas with benches, children's playgrounds, sports grounds and footpaths — 4,530 m² on the Block F and E site.

items.title: Parking below the building
items.text: Two underground parking levels are planned beneath Block E, with 86 spaces on the plans. Ask the sales team about buying or renting a space.

items.title: A layout for how you live
items.text: 1-room apartments from 30 m², 2-room around 50–52 m², 3-room from 61 to 79 m² and 4-room around 101–103 m². Each apartment has its own plan with room dimensions.

living.complexNote: The developer's description of the whole complex also mentions an outdoor swimming pool, car-free zones and 24/7 security. Ask the sales team which of these belong to the phase that includes Block E, and when they will open.

developer.title: Mono Capitals
developer.text: Mono Capitals is a property developer based in Tbilisi. The company describes its aim as the peace and comfort of future residents: a healthy environment, quality construction and modern infrastructure. Isani Park Residence is its multifunctional residential complex in the Isani district.
developer.logoNote: The mark on this site is a concept for a new identity, not the company's approved logo.

items.q: Which apartments are in Block E?
items.a: According to the design plans, Block E has 219 apartments on floors 1–10: 30 one-room (30–31 m²), 110 two-room (50–52 m²), 59 three-room (61–79 m²) and 20 four-room (101–103 m²). The sales team confirms which are available now.
The Georgian way: the living room counts as a room. A 1-room apartment is a studio with a kitchen area, a 2-room apartment has a living room and one bedroom. Each plan shows what every room is for.
It is the balcony or terrace. It is part of the total area and listed separately for each apartment: for example, 72.6 m² inside plus a 29.3 m² terrace makes 101.9 m².

items.q: How much does an apartment cost?
items.a: The price depends on the floor, layout and payment method, so it isn't published on the site. Send an enquiry or call, and the sales team will give you the current price for the apartment you choose.
The developer's official website lists an in-house instalment plan at 0%. The down payment and term are agreed individually — ask the sales team for a calculation.

items.q: When will Block E be completed?
items.a: An official completion date for Block E has not been published on the developer's website. Ask the sales team about the current construction stage and timeline.

items.q: Where can I see the materials and discuss a purchase?
items.a: At the Mono Capitals sales office: 1 D. Tavkhelidze St., Saburtalo, Tbilisi, open 10:00–18:00. Book a visit on +995 501 111 444.

From the enquiry form: your name, phone number, comment (if you left one) and the apartment number you selected.

Technical details of your visit: the landing page, the site language and advertising tags in the link (such as utm_source or gclid) if you arrived from an ad. They show which advertising leads to enquiries.
To call you back and answer your questions about apartments, prices and terms. We do not use form data for newsletters without your separate consent.

sections.h: Where it is kept and who receives it
p: Your enquiry is delivered to the sales team through the connected channel (a messenger or email) and kept there. The site is hosted by a hosting provider, which receives technical data such as your IP address when serving pages.
The interactive map loads from Google only after you press “Show interactive map”.
Analytics services (Google Analytics, Google Ads) run only after you agree in the banner. Your name and phone number are never sent to analytics. Declining does not affect the site.
The site remembers your theme, language and filters in your browser for convenience only.
Enquiry data is kept as long as needed to answer your request and complete a purchase. You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by writing to info@monocapitals.ge.
